protocol.population: new seeds 910000+1000*stratum+index; fixed inputs before outcomes
protocol.recovery: gap and middle-segment-midpoint Green modes, both vertical signs, 12 exact bisections, depth cap 24, node cap 10000
protocol.angular_fold: adapted a46 grid mechanism; 32 planar/Fibonacci directions plus signed axes; 48 log amplitudes [1e-4,16] after lift normalization; 201 samples/segment; exact check up to eight lowest float-cost sampled candidates; no local descent
protocol.onecut: adapted five-point commitment on deepest sampled violated segment/ball; 201 samples; both vertical signs; two child SDPs
protocol.guide: adapted two mirrored parabolic guides, height .8, 20 Bernstein cells per segment, same energy and exact affine basis
protocol.gate: strict physical p>0, rational coefficients, zero tolerance; requested positive margin 1e-8 where construction imposes a margin
protocol.arm_order: rotate [constructive,angular_fold,onecut,guide_qp] by global index modulo four
protocol.timing: one serial pass; root and setup reported separately; arm includes construction and exact gate; dual verification and independent replay reported separately
protocol.no_answer: retain every case and reason; root failure uses affine minimum-energy reference for constructive/cut methods; no gap means angular fold unknown
protocol.bounds: exact repaired root dual if valid, otherwise exact obstacle-free lower bound 16
protocol.selection: no filtering by success, sign, rank, objective gap, or endpoint condition
